The contract requirements mostly match current code, but there's a bug: need(end>offset||offset===text.length,...) throws when a nonempty read can't progress... Actually the current code throws when end===offset and offset<text.length — that matches "reject nonempty read that can't progress." Hmm, but "reject an interior start" — splitPair at offset? Current code doesn't check interior start offset. Requirement: reject interior start. Need to add: if splitPair(offset) throw 'inspection-range-splits-unicode' (interior start). Also interior end moves backward — done. So patch: add start check.

Also validate offset range etc. — done. Write full file.
